    How marketing teams can use Notion AI to boost productivity

    Notion AI simplifies your work as a marketer by writing brand new pages for you, extracting key insights from database pages, and quickly showing you the information you need.

    • Marketing
    • Notion AI
    • Demo
    3 min video

    • Notion AI can help improve written content by providing options to edit, summarize, or rewrite text based on specific prompts.

    • AI autofill is a useful tool for extracting key info from databases, making it easier to digest valuable data.

    • Notion Agent can quickly find specific info within a workspace, saving time and reducing the need to disrupt colleagues.
